snippet.description:
New Legacy Website and how to play:
➤ https://pokemonlegacy.com/xy-legacy

For those who have trouble setting the game up, bug reports or questions about the game, the best places to ask are the pokemon legacy discord or reddit:
➤ Discord: https://discord.gg/Wupx8tHRVS
➤ Reddit: https://www.reddit.com/r/PokemonLegacy

My Playthrough Channel:
➤ https://www.youtube.com/@SmithPlaysPlus

Instagram:
➤ https://www.instagram.com/thesmithplays/

Credits: Craig Livingstone (Production), Weebra (Editing)
Business Inquiries: thesmithplays@fixated.com
